name: Thumb Carpometacarpal Osteoarthritis
definition: Degenerative osteoarthritis of the first carpometacarpal joint causing pain and loss of pinch/grip function.

typical: Pain with pinch, jar opening or key grip

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is usually clinical and radiographic when needed.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs show joint-space loss, osteophytes and subluxation.

amber: Injection or surgery is considered for persistent function-limiting disease.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Sandhigata Vata correlation may be documented with modern joint diagnosis retained.

patientEducation.summary: Degenerative osteoarthritis of the first carpometacarpal joint causing pain and loss of pinch/grip function.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
